_comment: Provider cache E2E (shipped, item 11 + §29). Verifies Anthropic ephemeral cache markers produce cache_write_tokens on run 1 and cache_read_tokens on run 2 within the 5-min TTL. Uses claude-sonnet-4-6 (NOT haiku — haiku's real cacheable minimum is >2900 tokens, see dev guide §14). Two-run harness with a stable agent_session_id. Run twice within 5 min: ```set -a; source .env; set +a; unset ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; SESS=cache_$(date +%s); ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_anthropic_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info | tee /tmp/r1.sse; ./target/release/dag_engine run tests/graphs/agents/provider_cache_anthropic_e2e.json --agent-session-id $SESS --include-extra-info | tee /tmp/r2.sse; grep -oE '"cache_(read|write)_tokens":[0-9]+' /tmp/r{1,2}.sse```

config.system_message: You are a deterministic test agent for verifying Anthropic prompt caching. Reply with EXACTLY one line: 'cache_test_done'. Below this line is filler context whose ONLY purpose is to push the cacheable prefix comfortably past the 2048-token minimum that claude-haiku requires before the ephemeral cache marker takes effect. Ignore the filler semantically; never reference it in the reply. --- COLMENA project context (section 1): Colmena is a Rust-native AI agent orchestration library that exposes a hexagonal architecture (domain / application / infrastructure) and supports OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini providers behind a single LlmRepository trait. The DAG engine wires nodes declared in JSON; every node implements the ExecutableNode trait and emits outputs under the {output: ...} convention. Built-in node types include sql_query, http_request, python_script, image_generation, image_edit, tts, suspend, secure_suspend, trigger_webhook, router, output_parser, subgraph, and the orchestrator. Synthetic LLM tools include the gsheets_* family, the gdocs_* family, sql_inspect_attachment, sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment, attachment_run_python, load_attachment, load_skill, and describe_tool. Attachments flow through the OutputStorageRepository port; bytes persist uniformly at registration regardless of whether the source was inline, a signed URL, or a generated artifact. Skills load on demand via include_dir! with YAML frontmatter and a 64 KB cap. Lazy tool loading reveals tool schemas progressively through describe_tool. Conversational memory persists across sessions in Postgres keyed by agent_session_id with a fallback to the ephemeral session_id. Secure values are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM and require SECURE_VALUES_KEY at startup. --- COLMENA project context (section 2): The orchestrator coordinates a planner, an executor, a critic loop, and bridge tasks; subgraph nodes nest arbitrarily and HITL suspension propagates upward through suspend nodes using the canonical Q[id]/A[id] response format. RAG uses pgvector for similarity search. Streaming SSE carries node-start, node-end, and finish events; the finish event aggregates usage across every LlmUsage emitted during the run, surfacing promptTokens, completionTokens, totalTokens, and the optional thinkingTokens, cacheReadTokens, and cacheWriteTokens fields only when they are greater than zero. Attachment GC is a separate binary that deletes conversation_attachments rows and their backing blobs once they pass their TTL. The cache_control marker is ephemeral by default and lives for five minutes. Prompt caching cuts repeat-prefix cost by roughly ninety percent on Anthropic, Gemini 2.5 provides implicit server-side caching above its own minimums, and OpenAI caches automatically for prefixes over 1024 tokens. All three providers surface usage statistics in extra_info.usage so downstream dashboards can compute real cost. --- COLMENA project context (section 3): The Colmena workspace depends on sqlx, tokio, reqwest, schemars, serde, serde_json, anyhow, thiserror, pyo3, napi-rs, yrs, similar, pulldown_cmark, calamine, and rust_xlsxwriter. CI runs on the develop branch and enforces Conventional Commits plus cargo fmt and deny-warnings. Tests run via cargo test --verbose so doctests and integration tests are exercised together. The python sandbox validates LLM-authored code through an AST check before execution and wraps it in a wall-clock timeout. The gsheets node speaks the Google Sheets v4 REST API; the gdocs node speaks the Google Docs API v1 plus Drive v3. Documents store inline bytes or signed URLs; the gdocs co-edit guard tracks revisionId through the Drive Revisions API and computes paragraph-level diffs with the similar crate. SQL bulk insert streams CSV into Postgres via COPY FROM STDIN. Attachment uniform resolution allows the $attachment:<key> placeholder inside http_request multipart parts. The orchestrator emits phase markers in the SSE stream, and the DAG engine validates graph topology at load time before any node executes. --- COLMENA project context (section 4): The text registry under src/libs/colmena/text holds every prompt, tool description, and summary the model reads, expressed as YAML or Markdown so operators can change what the LLM sees without recompiling Rust. The node_configurations.json file is the canonical schema for every node type, listing fields, types, and defaults; node_as_tools_reference.json documents how each node is exposed as an LLM tool through tool_configurations, node_schema, fixed_config, and expose_sub_tools. Toolkit packages let a single alias such as gsheets, gdocs, gdocsread, or api_explorer expand to a curated bundle of tools, with bang-prefixed exclusions inside the same array. The temporal and geographic context block is auto-injected into every llm_call system message, carrying the current date, time, locale, and approximate location so the agent can reason about now without guessing. The multimedia generation pipeline ships three nodes — image_generation, image_edit, and tts — backed by artifact storage with local-cache, local-http, and http-callback adapters guarded by the COLMENA_LOCAL environment flag. Vertex uses application default credentials on Cloud Run, Gemini TTS auto-wraps linear-16 PCM into a playable WAV container, and the binary scrubber strips raw bytes from any tool payload before it crosses the SSE boundary. The router node selects a downstream branch from a closed label set, while the output_parser node coerces free-form model text into a typed JSON object validated against a schema. End of filler context. Reply with exactly: cache_test_done
